name: FloodGuard Tactical Rescue Operations Reference Knowledge Base
description: Comprehensive field conditions, rapid tactical SOPs, hydrological thresholds, Kamareddy GeoJSON grid sectors, and real-time situational telemetry for rescue teams and AI decision-support.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Lingapur Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Canal backflow corridor. NH44 underpass experiences rapid submergence >2.5m. Heavy transformer concentration along northern rural distribution lines.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Tekriyal Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Low-lying river confluence approach. Swiftwater velocities exceed 1.5 m/s during upstream dam gate opening. Key elevated bypass route runs along eastern ridge.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Adloor / Adlur Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Critical low basin (17.5m below district average). High probability of deep inundation (>2.0m) and residential isolation. Priority evacuation zone.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Sarampally Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Lowest elevation drainage basin in municipal grid network (502m). Severe flood entrapment risk; immediate amphibious/motorized boat deployment required.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Chinna Mallareddy Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Agricultural drainage runoff zone. Flash flood sheet flows across rural unpaved access roads.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Devanpally Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Eastern stormwater discharge zone. Culvert suction hazards and rapid stream pooling.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Rameshwarpally Sector
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Southern perimeter approach road subject to silt washouts and submerged bridge decks.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Kamareddy Town / Bus Stand
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Urban core and command staging hub. Commercial street waterlogging; primary access to Municipal Relief Camp.

kamareddy_key_sectors.name: Kamareddy Railway Station / Substation
kamareddy_key_sectors.terrain_note: Critical electrical feeder node (33/11kV). High risk of electrical step potentials if trackbed floods.

response_format_directive.rule: Every response must be short, covering key operational points, and ground real data from kmr_grids_ai_latlon.geojson and live web telemetry.
sections: 📍 AREA TELEMETRY: Real grid ID, elevation in meters, risk level, and safety score from GeoJSON.
🌦️ REAL-TIME SITUATION: Live weather, rain/precipitation rate from web, and water surge trend.
✅ DO NOW: Immediate tactical priority action.
⚠️ AVOID: Critical life-safety violation or hazard to shun.
📞 ESCALATE: Direct emergency contacts (DEOC 1077, Power 1912, Ambulance 108).

protocols.condition_summary: Water conducting lethal electrical voltage gradients (step potential and touch potential) from partially submerged 11kV transformers or buzzing power poles.

rapid_action.action: HALT 15M OUT: Cease all forward rescue craft advance immediately. Maintain a strict 15-meter (50-foot) clearance perimeter from the buzzing or sparking pole.
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT allow boat hull, aluminum oars, or wet ropes to enter the boiling/sparking water radius.
rapid_action.escalate: Call 1912 (Telangana Electricity Emergency) & DEOC Kamareddy (1077 / 08468-220050) for immediate feeder breaker trip.

tactical_sop: HALT 15M OUT: Cease forward craft movement immediately; maintain a 15m (50ft) standoff perimeter from energized water.
EMERGENCY SUBSTATION TRIP: Request immediate forced feeder breaker cutoff via Electricity Emergency (1912) and DEOC (1077).
REROUTE CRAFT: Reverse course and proceed via non-energized access route.

protocols.category: Rescue Boat Overload, Crowd Control & Capsizing Prevention
protocols.condition_summary: Panicked crowd rushing an inflatable rescue craft (IRB), risking sudden listing, pontoon tearing, and overturning in turbulent flood surge.

rapid_action.action: ENFORCE 8-PERSON LIMIT: Firmly state: 'Boat is at maximum safe capacity. We are returning immediately on Rotation #2.' Prioritize non-ambulatory, infants, and pregnant mothers.
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT allow citizens to board with heavy suitcases or push past the 8-passenger (750 kg) payload limit.
rapid_action.escalate: Leave tethered lifejackets/buoys with remaining group; dispatch secondary support craft via LoRa Channel 16.

tactical_sop: ENFORCE 8-PERSON LIMIT: Inflatable boats capsize instantly in surge if overloaded past 8 persons (750 kg).
TRIAGE BOARDING: Evacuate non-ambulatory patients, infants, pregnant mothers, and elderly first.
LEAVE LIFELINES: Anchor a certified lifeline tether with remaining citizens while ferrying rotation #1 to safety.

protocols.category: Hydrological Surge, Swiftwater Velocity & Rising Water
protocols.condition_summary: Water depth exceeding 1.5m and velocity exceeding 1.0 m/s with rapid rise rates (>0.3 m/h) creating deadly suction near culverts.

rapid_action.action: SWIFTWATER PROTOCOL: Mandatory motorized craft, Type V PFDs, and throw bags. Prohibit foot wading (15 cm knocks adult; 60 cm sweeps heavy trucks).
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT attempt foot wading or allow small unpowered dinghies in water flowing faster than 1.0 m/s.
rapid_action.escalate: Sound evacuation sirens for downstream grids if water rise rate exceeds 0.3 meters/hour.

tactical_sop: SWIFTWATER GEAR: Mandate Type V rescue vests, helmets, and throw ropes for all field personnel.
PROHIBIT WADING: Water moving > 1.0 m/s sweeps rescuers off feet; use motorized rescue craft exclusively.
MANDATORY EVACUATION: Depths > 1.5m or rise rates > 0.3m/h trigger automatic mandatory evacuation orders.

protocols.category: Medical Triage, Infant Hypothermia, Contamination & Snakebites
protocols.condition_summary: Trapped hypothermic infants, contaminated water causing leptospirosis, and displaced venomous snakes seeking dry high ground.

rapid_action.action: HYPOTHERMIA ACTION: Strip wet garments immediately. Place infant skin-to-skin against parent's chest and wrap in dry thermal space blanket.
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT apply ice, tourniquets, or cuts to snakebites; do NOT allow drinking of unboiled or chemically contaminated floodwater.
rapid_action.escalate: Dial 108 for Emergency Ambulance with Polyvalent Anti-Snake Venom (ASV) and pediatric warming gear.

tactical_sop: INFANT HYPOTHERMIA: Wet garments cause fatal hypothermia within 30 mins; strip wet clothes and wrap skin-to-skin in dry blankets.
SNAKEBITE CARE: Immobilize bitten limb below heart level; rush to Kamareddy District Hospital for ASV (Dial 108).
WATER CONTAMINATION: Raw floodwater contains toxic runoff and Leptospirosis; distribute sealed bottled water only.

protocols.category: Bridge Scour, Roadway Washouts & Lingapur Canal Hazard
protocols.condition_summary: Turbulent floodwater scouring sediment around bridge piers and pooling deeply (>2.5m) in low-lying NH44 underpasses.

rapid_action.action: REROUTE VIA BYPASS: Strictly avoid low-lying NH44 underpasses near Lingapur canal. Direct all logistical trucks, ambulances, and buses via the Tekriyal elevated bypass.
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT drive across water-covered bridges without structural scour clearance; water hides washed-out roadbeds.
rapid_action.escalate: Alert Traffic Police & Highways Authority to erect hard physical barricades at NH44 Lingapur approach.

tactical_sop: AVOID NH44 UNDERPASS: Water depth exceeds 2.5m at Lingapur canal underpass; all vehicles must use Tekriyal bypass.
SOUNDING POLES: Rescue craft must use sounding poles over flooded streets to detect open manholes and washed-out asphalt.
BRIDGE CLOSURES: Any bridge with water touching superstructure girder level must be closed immediately.

protocols.category: Kamareddy Municipal Evacuation Shelters & Relief Camps
protocols.condition_summary: Matching displaced flood evacuees to nearest elevated shelters safely outside the 100-year flood inundation zone.

rapid_action.action: PRIMARY SHELTER: Kamareddy Municipal High School Relief Camp (Cap: 250 | Generator, clean water, medical tent). Secondary: Govt Degree College Hall (Cap: 350).
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT route evacuees through flooded low-ground roads; use elevated MG Road approach.
rapid_action.escalate: Coordinate bed roll distribution and child nutrition rations through MRO Relief Cell.

tactical_sop: MUNICIPAL HIGH SCHOOL: Primary shelter on MG Road | Capacity: 250 occupants | 24/7 power backup & first-aid triage.
GOVT DEGREE COLLEGE: Secondary high-elevation concrete structure | Capacity: 350 occupants.
MRO COMMUNITY SHELTER: Staging post | Capacity: 150 occupants | Direct radio link to DEOC Control.

protocols.category: Submerged Vehicles, Stalled Cars & Trapped Motorists
protocols.condition_summary: Vehicle swept into canal or stalled in rising water with electrical windows failed and door pressure locked by outside water level.

rapid_action.action: VEHICLE ESCAPE: Unbuckle seatbelts. Remove seat headrest and jam metal prongs into lower corner of side window to shatter glass (windshields will not break). Climb onto roof.
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT waste energy trying to push doors open until water equalizes inside and outside; do NOT remain inside a sinking car.
rapid_action.escalate: Call 112 / 108 immediately and blow whistle to guide approaching rescue boats.

tactical_sop: SHATTER SIDE WINDOW: Use metal prongs of seat headrest against corner of side glass.
ROOFTOP STAGING: Evacuate passengers onto car roof immediately; never remain inside a sinking cabin.
TETHER LINE: Rescue boat must secure a tether line to the car frame to prevent current sweeping it away.

protocols.category: LoRa Sensor Telemetry, Mesh Degradation & Battery Depletion
protocols.condition_summary: Rain fade and muddy floodwater reflections causing RF packet attenuation and low sensor battery (<20%).

rapid_action.action: TELEMETRY LINK FIX: If RSSI < -110 dBm, re-hop packet through elevated Kamareddy repeater. Throttle reporting interval to 60s to conserve dying battery.
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT disregard sudden sensor dropouts during heavy rain; treat silent nodes as potential flood surge zones.
rapid_action.escalate: Dispatch mobile drone repeater or ground survey team to verify sector status.

tactical_sop: PACKET HOPPING: Re-route degraded LoRa packets (RSSI < -110 dBm) through elevated repeater towers.
BATTERY SAVING: Throttle depleted nodes (< 20%) to 60-second power-save transmissions.
PHYSICAL RECON: Treat sudden telemetry blackouts as high-risk surge alerts.

protocols.condition_summary: Immediate official contact numbers for rapid disaster escalation and emergency agency dispatch.

rapid_action.action: EMERGENCY CONTACTS: 112 (National Emergency), 108 (Disaster Ambulance), 1077 (DEOC Kamareddy: 08468-220050), 1912 (Power Cutoff), 011-23438084 (NDRF HQ).
rapid_action.do_not: DO NOT delay calling 1912 during electrical water emergencies or 108 for hypothermia/snakebite trauma.
rapid_action.escalate: Broadcast situation report on VHF Channel 16 for inter-agency coordination.

tactical_sop: 112 : Unified National Emergency Response Center
108 : Disaster Ambulance & Emergency Paramedic
1077 : Kamareddy District Emergency Operations Centre (08468-220050)
1912 : Telangana Electricity Emergency Substation Cutoff
011-23438084 : NDRF 24x7 National HQ Control Room
